kind: read-only design for GO existing D01 current-segment timing follow-up
existingContract: Task first start/completion/source already delivered; do not change or backfill UNKNOWN. Source status.mjs80-103, app.js175-195, plans/AGENTS.md139-147.

smallestAdditiveDesign.source: Optional current-segment fields in the same unique owner status top table, for example segment label, start UTC, end UTC or explicit OPEN/UNKNOWN, and source receipt. Exact names chosen once by original timing owner and documented in existing plans contract. No third-level task, extra manual status, timer or accumulated history database.
smallestAdditiveDesign.validation: Parse into a separate workSegment value with its own issues. Original task timing UNKNOWN must not invalidate a known segment; malformed segment must not erase valid task/review/main facts. Entire ISO UTC fields and one unique declaration, no free-prose extraction or commit/mtime/claim inference.
smallestAdditiveDesign.display: Preserve task start/end UNKNOWN. Add concise 本工作段历时（含等待，截至本次同步） for explicitly OPEN; closed end shows 本工作段已结束 with elapsed, never Task Done. Detailed segment name/start/end/source belongs in existing time-basis disclosure. No extra 4-line metadata block on every card.
smallestAdditiveDesign.clock: Use the same trusted live snapshot generatedAt and current/stale/frozen checks. No browser Date.now progression or elapsed timers; future/inverted interval unknown. Do not sum segments or subtract overlapping waits.
smallestAdditiveDesign.freshness: Existing timingObservations/updateTimingFreshness must invalidate both task and segment elapsed when an old detail/view loses current source. Do not leave a numerically frozen segment labeled active after refresh failure.
smallestAdditiveDesign.adoption: Only owners beginning a real later segment write observed times. A previous unknown task first start stays UNKNOWN. Replacing current-segment fields requires actual new start and source; old evidence remains referenced/committed, no fabricated historical batch.

meaningfulAcceptance: Task first-start UNKNOWN plus a known OPEN current segment displays only segment elapsed while retaining full-task unknown.
Closing segment on an incomplete task does not change delivery, TODO, review or main state.
Duplicate/invalid/missing source/future/reversed segment fields make only the segment unknown.
Stale/frozen/missing/current-mismatch snapshots invalidate both elapsed surfaces; ordinary rerender does not advance time.
Markup in segment name/source is escaped and source navigation retains existing path restrictions.
Already delivered timing and wait table behavior stays compatible; no summed net hours, new polling/timer or new manual store.
ownership: Original timing/dashboard owners must coordinate parser/public app/plans contract exact claims; root only research. Do not claim existing TIMING01/02 tests cover this new additive feature.
